definitions.name: G0A.SUM
definitions.note: sum of a numeric Vector (0 for empty)

definitions.name: G0A.MEAN
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V G0A.SUM V LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: arithmetic mean of a numeric Vector

definitions.name: G0A.ARGMAX
definitions.note: index of the first largest number in a Vector

definitions.name: G0A.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'V' BIND V LENGTH 'N' BIND V N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR N 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET G0A.MEAN
definitions.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector

definitions.name: G0A.MAD
definitions.body: 'X' BIND X X G0A.MEDIAN SUB G0A.ABS G0A.MEDIAN
definitions.note: median absolute deviation from the median

definitions.name: G0A.MOVING3
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
definitions.note: means of every three consecutive numbers

definitions.name: G0A.RUNMAX
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
definitions.note: running maximum of a non-empty numeric Vector

definitions.name: G0A.MODE
definitions.body: SORT TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES G0A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: most frequent number, smallest on ties

definitions.name: G0A.TRIMMED
definitions.note: mean after dropping one smallest and one largest

definitions.name: G0A.WORDS
definitions.note: split a String on single spaces into a Vector of words

definitions.name: G0A.UNWORDS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V 0 GET [ 'E' BIND ' ' E 3 COLLECT JOIN ] FOLD
definitions.note: join a non-empty Vector of Strings with single spaces

definitions.name: G0A.WLEN
definitions.note: number of characters in a String

definitions.name: G0A.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: upper-case the first letter of a non-empty String

definitions.name: G0A.BYNAME
definitions.body: ZIP [ 'N' 'A' ] BIND N A GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Record from name to summed amount, names in first-appearance order

solutions.prose.longest: G0A.WORDS 'W' BIND W W [ G0A.WLEN ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.prose.freq_top: G0A.WORDS TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES G0A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ G0A.WLEN 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.ledger.top_name: G0A.BYNAME 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES G0A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.ledger.debtors: G0A.BYNAME 'R' BIND R KEYS [ 'K' BIND R K GET 0 LT ] FILTER
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'E' BIND E E ZIP 1 GET G0A.ARGMAX GET
